scientific_integrity: Claims of novelty are limited to the publicly inspected record and do not assert independent validation or priority over unavailable manuscripts.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas for three square-window GCD families only; no formula for cobalancing-square windows, and the core gcd(k,B_k) is left as a finite index GCD. A publicly unverified follow-up manuscript on this exact subject was announced as in preparation in 2024; potential unpublished overlap persists.
title: Three exact square-window GCD laws for balancing companions
